teal.picks: Dataset and Variable Picker and Merge Module for 'teal' Applications

Source: R/teal.picks-package.R
teal.picks-package.Rd

Allows users to interactively select datasets, variables, and values within 'teal' applications using a 'tidyselect'-style interface. Selected picks can be merged and transformed into analysis-ready data within 'teal' modules.
